tools.name: find_churches_near
tools.description: Find Christian worship churches near the user, ranked by distance. Uses only the coarse location metadata ChatGPT shares, never raw location input fields. If the metadata includes only a city, it searches that city. Filter by worship style, denomination, or language.

tools.name: find_churches_in_city
tools.description: Find Christian worship churches in a named city, ranked by directory quality. Filter by worship style, denomination, or language.

tools.name: get_church
tools.description: Get the full profile for one church by its slug (the last path segment of its gospelchannel.com/church/<slug> URL): worship styles, denomination, language, summary, top worship songs, contact, and recorded service times if available.
